reviews.title: Worthless!
reviews.text:
This app was installed on my phone because I quickly needed to record a call. It isn’t quick at all! It’s horrible especially for seniors who need a learning curb! I immediately tried to cancel and get a refund but couldn’t!
Bottom line don’t waste your money!

reviews.text: Be aware that there is no free trial they charge you right away

reviews.title: Unacceptable, & misleading.
reviews.text: I’m trying to put my phone number in the app, but it won’t accept it.  I don’t have any cash in international number, I have a personal phone.  The app should’ve included information describing the need for an international phone before it requested my money.  Now I’ve played for a service that I cannot use.  I truthfully rate this app below the grading level offered.  I only chose the one star so that I could continue on to the comment section.

reviews.title: Worst
reviews.text: This app is the worst! Why should I have to call a number first to record a number? The entire point of a call recorder is to capture dynamic situations. You can’t do that with some garbage like this. I want a refund!

reviews.title: Complicated
reviews.text: Not easy to use long steps involved recording not working

reviews.title: No discretion
reviews.text: This app makes you call another number while on the line with the actual person you’re talking to.  They will probably notice it’s a three way call and if you have to call them while you’re on the phone they will also know.  If you do buy this app by accident, you won’t be refunded.  Stay away.

reviews.title: I do not reccomend
reviews.text:
I purchased 1 years use of this app a few days ago. Used it straightaway. None of the telephone numbers that need to  
be dialled to access the service worked. Call immediately dropped on dialling. Contacted customer support requesting a refund  and haven’t received a response.
Would give zero stars if it was possible.

reviews.title: Too complicated
reviews.text: I immediately regretted buying this app the minute I tried to use it. The marketing copy made it sound easy but I didn’t realize it’s a third party number you have to call and the number of the person you are calling has to be in your contacts and there’s no way I could figure out to make sure it’s actually recording while recording. Tried to get a refund but no dice. Should have just torn a $20 bill in pieces and flushed it down the john.
